issues.description: Method signature conflict for Milkable.messageOnMilk: The Problem Statement (Part 2 textual instructions) requires messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) that returns a string including the volume (e.g. "[Animal Type] [name] is milked (volume: [milkVolume]L)"), while the UML in the same Problem Statement and the provided code (solution and template Main) declare and use a parameterless messageOnMilk() returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". This mismatch (parameter vs. no-parameter) leaves students uncertain which signature to implement and will cause compilation/test failures if they follow the wrong variant.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and code consistent. Either: (A) Adopt the parameterless form used in the UML and code: update the Part 2 textual instructions to require messageOnMilk() (no parameter) and specify the return format as "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"; or (B) Adopt the volume-parameter form in all artifacts: change the UML, the Milkable interface (and all its implementations), the template Main usage, and any tests to declare messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and return strings including the volume (e.g. "[Animal Type] [name] is milked (volume: [milkVolume]L)"). Ensure the template code and example Main are updated to reflect the chosen signature so students and tests are aligned.
